# ui::Strings

Header: `winui/core/Strings.hpp`.

The text libwinui itself shows or gives screen readers, English by default. An app that shows another language replaces it with [set_strings()](namespace-ui.md#set_strings), and every control follows at once.

A field holding `{0}` or `{1}` is a pattern: the control puts a value in each slot, so a translation can place them where its language wants them. `{{` and `}}` write a brace. A field whose wording depends on a number is a function of that number, so a translation can apply its own plural rules.

A control's own text wins over these: a [ToggleSwitch](../controls/toggle-switch.md#uitoggleswitch) with `.checked_text` shows that, and a [Pager](../controls/pager.md#uipager) with `.prefix_text` that. Field names stay as they are; new fields are appended.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Strings german = ui::strings(); // starts from the current set: what is not set stays
german.commands.copy        = {"Kopieren", "Die Auswahl in die Zwischenablage kopieren"};
german.commands.select_all  = {"Alles auswählen", "Den ganzen Inhalt auswählen"};
german.keys.ctrl            = "Strg";
german.toggle_switch.on     = "Ein";
german.toggle_switch.off    = "Aus";
german.pager.page_number    = "Seite {0}";
german.person_picture.badge = [](std::size_t n) { return n == 1 ? "1 Element" : std::format("{} Elemente", n); };
ui::set_strings(std::move(german));
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `commands` | `StandardCommandsText` |  | The standard commands. |
| `keys` | `KeysText` |  | The key names in shortcut text. |
| `common` | `CommonText` |  | Wording several controls share. |
| `window_frame` | `WindowFrameText` |  | The caption buttons. |

## struct CommandText

A standard command's text and the description shown as its tooltip.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `std::string` |  | The label on a button or menu item. |
| `description` | `std::string` |  | The tooltip, a sentence saying what the command does. |

## struct StandardCommandsText

The sixteen standard commands ([standard_command()](../tree/namespace-ui.md#standard_command)). The text menus of the text controls use the same labels for Cut, Copy, Paste, Select All, Undo and Redo.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cut` | `CommandText` | `{"Cut", "Remove the selected content and put it on the clipboard"}` | Cut. |
| `copy` | `CommandText` | `{"Copy", "Copy the selected content to the clipboard"}` | Copy. |
| `paste` | `CommandText` | `{"Paste", "Insert the contents of the clipboard at the current location"}` | Paste. |
| `select_all` | `CommandText` | `{"Select All", "Select all content"}` | Select All. |
| `delete_selection` | `CommandText` | `{"Delete", "Delete the selected content"}` | Delete. |
| `share` | `CommandText` | `{"Share", "Share the selected content"}` | Share. |
| `save` | `CommandText` | `{"Save", "Save your changes"}` | Save. |
| `open` | `CommandText` | `{"Open", "Open"}` | Open. |
| `close` | `CommandText` | `{"Close", "Close"}` | Close. |
| `pause` | `CommandText` | `{"Pause", "Pause"}` | Pause. |
| `play` | `CommandText` | `{"Play", "Play"}` | Play. |
| `stop` | `CommandText` | `{"Stop", "Stop"}` | Stop. |
| `forward` | `CommandText` | `{"Forward", "Go to the next item"}` | Forward. |
| `backward` | `CommandText` | `{"Backward", "Go to the previous item"}` | Backward. |
| `undo` | `CommandText` | `{"Undo", "Reverse the most recent action"}` | Undo. |
| `redo` | `CommandText` | `{"Redo", "Repeat the most recently undone action"}` | Redo. |

## struct DateTimeText

[CalendarView](../controls/calendar-view.md#uicalendarview), [CalendarDatePicker](../controls/calendar-date-picker.md#uicalendardatepicker), [DatePicker](../controls/date-picker.md#uidatepicker) and [TimePicker](../controls/time-picker.md#uitimepicker).

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `previous` | `std::string` | `"Previous"` | The calendar's button to the previous month, year or decade. |
| `next` | `std::string` | `"Next"` | The calendar's button to the next month, year or decade. |
| `today` | `std::string` | `"{0}, today"` | A calendar day's name when it is today: {0} the day's own name. |
| `pick_a_date` | `std::string` | `"Pick a date"` | What a [CalendarDatePicker](../controls/calendar-date-picker.md#uicalendardatepicker) shows while no date is picked. |
| `today_footer` | `std::string` | `"Today: {0}"` | The line under a classic month calendar: {0} today's date. |
| `day` | `std::string` | `"day"` | A [DatePicker](../controls/date-picker.md#uidatepicker)'s and [TimePicker](../controls/time-picker.md#uitimepicker)'s parts: what the field shows in each while there is no value, and what automation calls each column. |
| `month` | `std::string` | `"month"` | See [`day`](#struct-datetimetext). |
| `year` | `std::string` | `"year"` | See [`day`](#struct-datetimetext). |
| `hour` | `std::string` | `"hour"` | See [`day`](#struct-datetimetext). |
| `minute` | `std::string` | `"minute"` | See [`day`](#struct-datetimetext). |
| `period` | `std::string` | `"period"` | What automation calls the AM/PM column. |
| `accept` | `std::string` | `"Accept"` | The picker flyout's button that keeps the choice. |
| `dismiss` | `std::string` | `"Dismiss"` | The picker flyout's button that drops it. |
